---
name: validate-ac-implementation
description: Validate some points in the AC
disable-model-invocation: true
---
## Before starting
- If no (<number>_ac.md) file is select ask the user for confirmation
- The user should select some parts or the whole will be evaluated

# Validation rules
- Validate the implementation, if you are unsure ask the user for confirmation. don't present information for something it's not 100% clear.
- Check the [Architecture](../../documentation/Architecture-Summary.md) for the whole implementation
- Check the [Architecture](../../documentation/Frontend-Architecture-Overview.md) for the frontend implementation
- If you have any doubts concerning the implementation, ask the user for confirmation before marking any point as completed, or before creating a todo item. 
- Sometimes the acceptance criteria points are not well explained, if you are not sure about the meaning of a point, ask the user for confirmation before marking it as completed or before creating a todo item.
- If you find some similar implementation that covers the same point, ask the user for confirmation before marking it as completed or before creating a todo item.

# On missing, failed acceptance criteria points
- If some points are missing add to a todo list on (<number>_todo.md), with some check boxes, add subtasks also with checkboxes if needed, create groups if it better organizes the todo list
- If some todos already exist, order them by priority or dependence.

# On Validation
- mark the task on the (<number>_ac.md) files completed [x], recalculate the total completed tasks.
